title: receive_frame() does not validate destination address matches local node
description:
Location: rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs line 515

receive_frame() parses the frame's dst_addr field but does not verify it matches the local node's IID or is a broadcast address. The frame is accepted if signature and replay checks pass, regardless of intended recipient.

This is likely intentional behavior (promiscuous mode, relaying, broadcast handling), but should be documented with a SECURITY comment explaining:
1. Why destination filtering is not performed at link layer
2. Where callers should filter if needed (upper layer)

If unintentional, frames intended for other nodes could be processed, wasting resources.
